name: triage-fix-verify
summary: For bug reports. First prove each bug with a failing test, then fix, then check with a second agent.

roles.name: triager
roles.job: Reads the bug report and the code. Finds the cause of each problem. Writes one failing test for each problem.

roles.name: fixer
roles.job: Changes the code so that the failing tests pass. Makes the smallest correct change.

roles.name: verifier
roles.job: Did not write the fix. Reviews the change, looks for missed cases and runs all tests.

steps.do: For each problem in the report, find the cause in the code. Write a failing regression test for it.
Fix the code until all tests pass. Do not change the meaning of the existing tests.
Review the diff against the report and the rules in the README. Look for related bugs that the report did not name. Send problems back to the fixer.

rules: Each problem in the report must have its own test.
The verifier must not be the same agent as the fixer.
Repeat fix and verify until the verifier accepts the change.
